data.one_liner: Generate and verify Time-based One-time Passwords (TOTP) following RFC 6238.
data.what_it_does: An implementation of the Time-based One-time Password algorithm that generates tokens, verifies codes with optional symmetric windows, and calculates remaining time periods with subsecond precision. It supports base32 keys and various cryptographic hash algorithms.
use_when: You need to implement multi-factor authentication (MFA) or two-factor authentication (2FA).
You are building a client that needs to generate or verify RFC 6238 compliant TOTP tokens.
avoid_when: You need built-in state persistence or automatic replay attack prevention during verification.
strengths: Supports customizable algorithms (SHA1, SHA256, SHA512), periods, and digit counts.
Provides precise Duration-based time remaining calculations.
weaknesses: Verification does not persist state or prevent replay, requiring manual tracking in your application.
